purpose: ADS-B linking fix for departures WITHOUT an NM flight record at EDDF / EHAM. The matcher (src/prc2026_adsb/features.match_departures) keys such rows on FLIGHT_mvt, which carries the IATA airline designator ('KL1787'), while ADS-B callsigns use the ICAO designator, so they never match. tools/adsb_rematch_nonm.py maps the IATA prefix to ICAO (fixed table) and runs the unchanged segment code with the learned stands. Rows whose existing key finds nothing but whose mapped callsign yields a gate-covered segment get the observed ADS-B taxi time blended into the prediction. Fair development rows; no model is fitted.

prior_context.note: Declared AFTER an exploratory look at the development rows (disclosed): on the 198 newly gate-matched no-NM rows of the four recipe months, v34's RMSE is 236 s, the raw ADS-B taxi (with an offset from those same months' regular gate rows) 216 s, the 50/50 blend 142 s (every month better), 75/25 160 s. The candidate scores below were NOT computed under this declaration's offsets before it was written.
prior_context.exploration_offsets_not_used: median label - (takeoff - motion_start) on regular gate rows of the recipe months: EDDF 60.5 s, EHAM 6.9 s
prior_context.ranking_exposure_label_free: 163 newly gate-matched ranking rows (January 115: EHAM 110; July 48); EHAM 3-7 January 2026 precise subset: observed taxi 2,456 s against v34 2,206 s and fold side 2,473 s

rematch.inputs: departures with FLIGHT_ID_mvt missing at EDDF / EHAM: 2025-01 + 2025-12 (arcw5), 2025-07 + 2025-11 (arcw2), ranking (arcw1); adsb.lol surface files (ODbL) on those workers
rematch.scope: rows with no key_icao and an iata_mapped segment whose gate flag is true

offset: per airport, the median of label - (takeoff - motion_start) over the regular gate-matched departures (data/external/adsblol/matches_v11/matches2_<month>.parquet, gate true) of the NON-recipe 2025 months 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 08, 09, 10 (labels from data/raw/training_*.parquet); the same constant serves every recipe month and the ranking
candidate_semantics: value = max(w * (takeoff - motion_start + offset[airport]) + (1 - w) * base_value, floor) on the scope's rows, base_value = the control (cs*) or the control with configs/disagreement_gate_v1.json's u300 gate applied (u300_cs*); every other row keeps base_value
selection: Unchanged rule: eligible when no recipe month is worse on ALL rows, the mean ratio is at least 0.02% below 1, and every touched month's paired-day 95% interval lies below zero; lowest mean ratio among eligible; otherwise keep v34. December reported separately. u300's own result stays as recorded in docs/disagreement/gate_v1_results.json (not selected).
ship: delta on the ranking rows in scope = candidate value - v34's value (from v34's rebuilt floats and, for u300_cs*, the u300 gate delta), added to v34's floats, floor -12 s; independent check; audit; upload only on the user's decision.
